# ClipBo Release Artifacts

This directory contains official pre-packaged macOS disk images (`.dmg`) for ClipBo.

## 💿 Available Downloads

| File | Architecture | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **[ClipBo.dmg](ClipBo.dmg)** | `arm64` (Apple Silicon) | Primary drag-to-install release disk image. |
| **[ClipBo-0.6.4.dmg](ClipBo-0.6.4.dmg)** | `arm64` (Apple Silicon) | Versioned release artifact for v0.6.4. |

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download **[ClipBo.dmg](ClipBo.dmg)** (or click "Download Raw File" on GitHub).
2. Double-click `ClipBo.dmg` to mount the disk image.
3. Drag `ClipBo.app` into your `Applications` folder.
4. Launch ClipBo from Applications or Spotlight (`⌘ Space`).
